findings.title: Deep nesting (depth 8)
findings.evidence: Max indentation depth 8 - control flow is hard to follow.
findings.recommendation: Flatten with early returns / guard clauses; extract inner blocks.

findings.title: Broad exception handling
findings.evidence: Bare or Exception-wide `except` swallows errors indiscriminately.
findings.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions; re-raise or log the rest.
